judged_text: `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` re-renders the serializer without persisting anything, so the advertised PUT /admin/customize/embedding is a no-op that returns 200 while discarding its payload. The only client caller, `saveChanges()` in admin-embedding.js.es6 (`this.get('embedding').update({})`), is wired to no button in embedding.hbs, so the entire embedding-level save path is dead on the client and a silent no-op on the server — the next person wiring a save button inherits an endpoint that loses data while appearing to succeed.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds PUT /admin/customize/embedding (routes.rb) and a client action `saveChanges()` that would call `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` does not read params or persist anything; it just `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` where `@embedding` is an OpenStruct built in `fetch_embedding`. Also, `embedding.hbs` has no button wired to `saveChanges`, so this save path is currently unused. This is a real, diff-grounded incompleteness/misleading API surface rather than a currently-triggered defect.
